name: sirius_b
label: Sirius B (DA2 white dwarf)
sources: EON-SII design study (arXiv:2608.17444), Table 2: V magnitudes (taken as AB at 475 nm; the white dwarfs are hot, B-V ~ 0), diameters and hours to 10 / 5 / 2 % precision per detector case
notes: ld_u 0.3 is the linear coefficient used by scripts/eonsii_crosscheck.py; the Monte Carlo campaign draws a uniform disk (ld_u 0) as its truth.
The paper's Monte Carlo: theta 0.02955 +/- 0.0014 mas with the MCP-PMT in 10 h (campaigns/mc_sirius_b_eonsii.json).
